metadata.precision: FP32 parameters, forward, derivatives; highest matmul; FP64 eigendecomposition
metadata.loss: next-token cross entropy plus configured z-loss; vanilla attention; unfused loss

selection.rule: Distinct products nearest equally spaced log-product targets; stable index tie breaking

derivative_checks.requirement: Two adjacent step sizes below 2% relative HVP error in each tested mode

metadata.measurement_resolution: Assess derivative/batch stability; 1e-12 is only a numerical gate

projected_resolution.method: Two finite-difference scales; diagonal congruence scaling; spectral discrepancy margin
projected_resolution.warning: Empirical agreement screen, not a rigorous bound on systematic differentiation error
projected_resolution.reason: Minimum scaled eigenvalue must exceed ten times the measured discrepancy

interpretation: r and rho describe centered matrix-log agreement in this declared subspace.
rho is an explained fraction, not an identified physical noise reliability.
alpha_log minimizes a matrix-log mismatch surrogate; it is not a measured training-loss optimum.
The exact congruence grid is computed on projected matrices; extending it to the full block requires small projection leakage.
Matrix logs do not linearize a noncommuting congruence. Inspect the commutator and direct congruence grid.
No Gram-estimation uncertainty is identifiable from one fixed history.

split_validation.partition: even-indexed batches fit; odd-indexed batches evaluate

curvature_batch_bootstrap.warning: These intervals condition on the saved EMA, checkpoint, selected subspace, and valid replicates. They do not measure EMA noise or training-seed uncertainty. Invalid replicates must be reported.

mean_hvp_leakage.warning: Computed from averaged HVPs, not an average of per-batch ratios; refers to the unshifted target.

per_batch_leakage_diagnostic.warning: Ratios are measured per batch; their mean is not the leakage of the averaged curvature operator and may overstate persistent mismatch.
